title: 第24章 跟踪
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
林奇提着沉甸甸的木盒，从万卡阁往家走。

    他心里盘算着回去后先融合一部分铁剑卡，补足商铺的库存，再研究怎么用新到手的骷髅卡提升本命卡。

    距离奇妙物语商铺还有两条街时，林奇的脚步突然顿住。

    跟在他脚边的风铃猫最先察觉异常，原本耷拉着的三角耳朵瞬间竖得笔直，喉咙里滚出低沉的呜咽。

    一双蓝宝石般的瞳孔骤然收缩，死死锁定右侧街角。

    “怎么了风铃？”

    林奇顺着风铃猫的视线看去，只见街角的阴影里，隐约露出半截黑色的衣角，还有一道模糊的人影，显然是有人躲在那里偷窥自己。

    “万卡阁的人？还是其他佣兵团的？”

    林奇心里泛起嘀咕，手心悄悄藏着持剑骷髅的卡牌。

    他料想过会有不安好心的人来打探自己底细，甚至是找麻烦。

    毕竟奇妙物语商铺今天只销售了一星器具卡，并没有宣传高星卡牌。这也让旁人无法证实林峰是不是真的制卡师。

    若这些卡牌是他运气好捡来的，那会不会还有其他卡牌？

    或者，他真的得了制卡师传承。

    毕竟在源卡大陆是有着一些卡牌秘境的。

    因为从里面可以获得稀有卡牌，所有总有御卡师前赴后继的进入秘境。

    而死在里面的人也不在少数，这也导致一些制卡师临死前会把自己的传承封存进卡牌里，等待有缘人来继承。

    若林峰只是侥幸继承了制卡师的遗产，那他的处境可就危险了，各大佣兵团和贵族就会想尽办法争抢他。

    而若是争抢不到，很有可能出手毁掉。

    毕竟这里是石铁城，地处偏僻。

    林峰想要登记制卡师的身份，也得前往公国，那距离可就遥远了...

    可若是真像那些谣言，说林峰是十年前被制卡大师收为弟子，这种有着师承的制卡师就不能得罪了。

    毕竟这个世界制卡师的地位十分超然。

    每一位制卡大师背后站着的力量都足以让公国抖三抖，若是自己徒弟发生意外，那么根本不需要找凶手，石铁城一个小小的三级城镇，直接全城人陪葬就行。

    林奇拍了拍风铃猫的脑袋，指了指旁边的房顶。

    “风铃，去房顶绕过去，看看那人是谁。”

    风铃猫立刻会意，后腿轻轻一蹬，像片沾了风的羽毛，悄无声息地跃上矮房的瓦片，连一点声响都没弄出来。
content_en:
Lin Qi carried the heavy wooden box and walked home from Wanka Pavilion.

    He mentally planned to fuse some of the Iron Sword Cards to replenish the store's inventory after returning, and then study how to use the newly acquired Skeleton Cards to improve his Life Cards.

    When he was still two blocks away from the Wonderful Story store, Lynch's steps suddenly stopped.

    The wind chime cat following at his feet was the first to notice the abnormality. The triangular ears that were originally drooping stood up straight in an instant, and a low whimper rolled out of his throat.

    A pair of sapphire-like pupils suddenly shrank and locked on the street corner on the right.

    "What's wrong with the wind chime?"

    Lin Qi followed the wind chime cat's line of sight and saw half of the black clothes in the shadow at the corner of the street, as well as a blurry figure. It was obvious that someone was hiding there to peek at him.

    "People from Wanka Pavilion? Or from other mercenary groups?"

    Lin Qi murmured in his heart, secretly hiding the card of a sword-wielding skeleton in his palm.

    He expected that some uneasy and well-meaning people would come to inquire about his details, or even cause trouble.

    After all, the Wonder Story store only sold one-star equipment cards today and did not promote high-star cards. This also makes it impossible for others to confirm whether Lin Feng is a real card maker.

    If he picked up these cards by luck, would there be other cards?

    Or maybe he really has the inheritance of a card maker.

    After all, there are some secret card realms in the Source Card Continent.

    Because rare cards can be obtained from it, there are always card masters entering the secret realm one after another.

    There are also many people who have died inside, which has also led some card makers to seal their inheritance into cards before they die, waiting for someone destined to inherit it.

    If Lin Feng was just lucky enough to inherit the card maker's inheritance, then his situation would be in danger, and major mercenary groups and nobles would try their best to fight for him.

    And if you can't fight for it, it's very likely to be destroyed.

    After all, this is Shitie City, located in a remote location.

    If Lin Feng wants to register as a card maker, he has to go to the principality, and the distance is quite long...

    But if those rumors are true, saying that Lin Feng was accepted as a disciple by a master card maker ten years ago, then such a card maker with such a long history cannot be offended.

    After all, the status of card makers in this world is very transcendent.

    The power behind each card-making master is enough to make the principality tremble. If something happens to his apprentice, there is no need to find the murderer. Shitie City is a small third-level town, and the whole city can be buried with him.

    Lin Qi patted the wind chime cat on the head and pointed to the roof next to it.

    "Wind Chime, go around the roof and see who that person is."

    The wind chime cat immediately understood, and with a slight kick of its hind legs, like a feather caught in the wind, it silently jumped onto the tiles of the low house without making any sound.
